english.title: Use bus / minibus – illegible date marked on re-treaded tyre sidewall

english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 27(1)(k) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 41A of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
used on road
a bus / minbus
when the wheels fitted with a pneumatic tyre
were re-treaded and date marked on tyre sidewall in accordance with ECE re 30 / 54 / 108 / 109
was illegible

other.penalty:
Summary -

A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

Fixed penalty ticket - one hundred pounds and licence endorsed three penalty points.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
